title: Marvel's Wolverine hits 2.4M sales, PS5 at 97.9M 🎮
subject: wolverine
description:
Did you pick up Wolverine yet? 👇

In its earnings report for July–September 2026, published November 5, Sony said Marvel's Wolverine has sold more than 2.4 million units as of November 4. PS5 shipped 2.6 million consoles in the quarter for 97.9 million lifetime, PlayStation hit a record 127 million monthly active users for September, and Sony said PS6 development is making solid progress.

Sources: Sony Q2 FY2026 earnings, VGC (Nov 5, 2026), Push Square (Nov 5, 2026), GamingBolt (Nov 5, 2026)

scenes.text: Marvel's Wolverine has sold 2.4 million copies.
Sony shared the number in its earnings report on November 5, counting sales through November 4.
The game launched September 15. Spider-Man 2 sold 2.5 million on its first day.
PS5 shipped 2.6 million consoles last quarter, bringing the total to 97.9 million.
PlayStation also reached a record 127 million monthly active users for a September.
As for PS6, CFO Lin Tao said development is making solid progress.
